_comment: Playtest switches: not game data and not player-facing. They let the board try work that the normal run cannot reach yet. Each key is independent and read by its own task's code. flamethrower_at_start (task T-042): true gives the car the exhaust flamethrower at the start of every run; false (the game's rule, set in T-052 now that the level-up screen offers it) starts every run without it, and the first level-up offers it. Read by scripts/weapons/flamethrower/exhaust_flamethrower.gd. kaiju_early_arrival (task T-045): when enabled is true, the kaiju arrives after_seconds into the run instead of at the boss time (3 minutes in since the 4-minute run, T-520; was 7); false (the game's rule) brings it at the boss time. Only the kaiju's arrival moves: the clock, the minions' growth and the boss time signal stay as they are. Read by scripts/enemies/kaiju_boss.gd. Set back to false right before T-045 merges. underglow_at_start (task T-168): true gives the car the neon underglow at the start of every run, until the level-up offers it; false (the game's rule) starts every run without it. Read by scripts/weapons/neon_underglow.gd. molotov_at_start (task T-169): true gives the car the molotovs at the start of every run, until the level-up offers them; false (the game's rule) starts every run without them. Read by scripts/weapons/molotovs.gd. wiper_at_start (task T-170): true gives the car the windshield wiper at the start of every run, until the level-up offers it; false (the game's rule) starts every run without it. Read by scripts/weapons/windshield_wiper.gd. bricks_at_start (task T-324): true gives the car Bricks at the start of every run; false (the game's rule) starts every run without it, and level-ups offer it. Read by scripts/weapons/bricks.gd. all_weapons_at_start (task T-172): true gives the car every weapon at tier 1 at the start of every run, for the integration check and the board's playtest; false (the game's rule) starts every run with only the gun. Never visible to players. Read by scripts/weapons/weapons.gd. weapon_tier_at_start (task T-500): an integer, 0 = off (the game's rule). When it is 1 or more and all_weapons_at_start is true, every weapon starts the run at that tier, capped at its own last tier (max_tier), with every tier applied in order as if levelled up; the level-ups then offer only what is left. Never visible to players. Read by scripts/weapons/weapons.gd.
